name: Summer Internship
description: Students will be interning in an organization to develop experience in application of chemical engineering principles and to develop skills in communication, working efficiently in a team, learn to collaborate and gain exposure to practical/industry relevant problems in chemical engineering. Students will be assigned a project by their reporting officer, where they have to work on problems related to their internship using engineering methods.
